daemon-boost-two-pet-accuracy-aura.head: e9d73a9c
daemon-boost-two-pet-accuracy-aura.scope: Stock activated 619 for 2 s, 20 IS and 15 s own reuse. At level 50, 700 applied +64 melee, ballistic and viral accuracy to the own Rifle, the 10.00 m friendly Karate and the nearby friendly Nuker only. The 10.01 m and opposing pets were excluded. A 5 IS refresh spent 9→4, then shortfall stopped the parent with zero later pulses. The surviving proxy reported zero accuracy after child expiry.

aura.source: The authored 619 uses ApplyAuraEffect on activation and each five-second update to refresh 700. ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation supplies the periodic affordability check. GOB 700 limits every pulse to friendly simulacra within 10 m.
aura.runtime: The shared scheduler dispatches the immediate and paid periodic friendly-pet pulses, stops the parent on shortfall with no refresh and lets the final child expire naturally.
aura.test: PR899 stock saw the correct three admitted pets and both exclusions, the immediate and paid five-second pulse, then one off on shortfall with no subsequent upkeep or pulse and the final own accuracy returning to zero. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

stats.source: GOB 619 stores 20 IS, 2 s cast, 15 s reuse, ApplyAuraEffect child 700, and a 5 IS drain every 5 s with ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation.
stats.runtime: AbilityAuras checks affordability before publishing each refresh. It debits the stored upkeep and reports ordinary vitals; a shortfall stops the toggle with no debit.
stats.test: AurasReadTheirDrainAndEffectFromTheTemplate verifies the stored child and drain. PR899 stock records 29→9 at activation and 9→4 at upkeep, followed by a shortfall and no later charge. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

pets.source: GOB 619 stores 20 IS, 2 s cast, 15 s reuse, ApplyAuraEffect child 700, and a 5 IS drain every 5 s with ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation. Child 700 admits friendly Simulacra in its 10 m circle.
pets.runtime: The parent applies to live friendly Simulacra in the caster's district. Each pet gets a typed, source-bound snapshot that expires independently.
pets.test: DaemonAccuracyUsesTheTenMetreFriendlyBoundaryAndThreeActualAttackChannels and daemon-boost-accuracy-server check the live range and ownership. Stock saw exactly three eligible pets and no out-of-range or hostile owner. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

script.source: GOB 619 stores 20 IS, 2 s cast, 15 s reuse, ApplyAuraEffect child 700, and a 5 IS drain every 5 s with ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation.
script.runtime: AbilityAuras starts the actual 619 activation with an immediate 700 pulse, debits 5 IS before each later refresh, and ends the parent at shortfall. The finite child retains its natural five-second expiry.
script.test: AurasReadTheirDrainAndEffectFromTheTemplate and daemon-boost-accuracy-server cover the mapped source, active effects and unload. Stock verifies the immediate/paid pulses, one shortfall off, and cleanup. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

source-parity.source: GOB 619 stores 20 IS, 2 s cast, 15 s reuse, ApplyAuraEffect child 700, and a 5 IS drain every 5 s with ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation.
source-parity.runtime: The script callbacks supply the source, amount, cadence and stop condition. The runtime publishes the deterministic child values independently of the server's common pet roll baseline.
source-parity.test: The live daemon-boost-accuracy-server and stock PR899 scenarios verify the documented activation and aura behavior. The native comment abbreviates the first 619 request. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

behavior-tests.source: GOB 619 stores 20 IS, 2 s cast, 15 s reuse, ApplyAuraEffect child 700, and a 5 IS drain every 5 s with ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation.
behavior-tests.runtime: The ordinary cast and shared aura scheduler preserve the stored parent cost/timing and the per-recipient finite effects across paid ticks, shortfall, unload and source removal.
behavior-tests.test: DaemonAccuracyAndDamageChildrenKeepIndependentExpiriesAndSourceLifetimes, daemon-boost-accuracy-server and PR899 verify independent expiration and same-rank refresh/stop behavior. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

area.source: GOB 700 selects friendly Simulacra (selector 19) within 10 m of the caster, with no stored angle.
area.runtime: Eligible pet stands are checked in a caster-centered area at each parent pulse, and the runtime rejects opposing and retired pets.
area.test: DaemonAccuracyUsesTheTenMetreFriendlyBoundaryAndThreeActualAttackChannels checks the live edge. Stock saw a pulse at 10.00 m and none at 10.01 m or on the closer opposing pet. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

pets.source: Child 700 stores separate function-3 caster-level modifiers for melee 522, ballistic 524 and viral 342, at scale 1.3 for 5 s.
pets.runtime: Each active snapshot supplies only the attacking pet's matching channel to its actual attack roll. Healer output and expired or stale snapshots receive no accuracy contribution.
pets.test: DaemonAccuracyConsumesOnlyTheAttackingPetChannel uses deliberately distinct values so it detects a wrong channel. The server replay observes actual melee and viral +64 attack inputs, and stock checks all three +64 fields on each eligible live pet. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

source-parity.source: GOB 700 authors the friendly radius, three accuracy inputs, scale, and lifespan. The shared hit-curve baseline is common pet combat policy.
source-parity.runtime: The runtime applies the authored contribution exactly once in the ordinary pet attack roll, preserving the same baseline when the effect expires or the wrong channel is used.
source-parity.test: DaemonAccuracyConsumesOnlyTheAttackingPetChannel and daemon-boost-accuracy-server verify the contribution itself, including a live fixed-roll miss→hit→miss. Stock independently verifies scope, all three actual field values, and expiration to zero. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126

behavior-tests.source: The sourced 700 pulse supplies the three typed values to eligible friendly pets for five seconds. An eligible parent refresh replaces the current contribution.
behavior-tests.runtime: The pet consumes the matching typed input until expiry. Independent source and sibling auras have separate effects, and healing stays unaffected.
behavior-tests.test: DaemonAccuracyAndDamageChildrenKeepIndependentExpiriesAndSourceLifetimes and daemon-boost-accuracy-server verify attack consumption and cleanup. Stock observed the immediate/refresh values, the boundary controls and zero remaining accuracy. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/899#issuecomment-7098379126
